newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela to supply 165,000 bpd oil to Sweeny.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to supply 165,000 bpd oil to Sweeny.

text.p: Venezuela will supply 165,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil to Phillips Sweeny refinery according to a deal expected to be signed within the next month or so, an director of state oil subsidiary Corpoven said on Thursday.
The supply deal will go hand in hand with Venezuela's plans to take a 50 percent share in building a new $500 million coker at the 200,000 bpd refinery, he added.
The 65,000 bpd coker would enable the Texas-based refinery to run Venezuela's heavy 16 API Merey crude instead of its existing diet of light Middle Eastern oil, the official said.
The coker deal would be ring-fenced, he added, and would not imply Corpoven taking a stake in the main body of the plant.
